user_query: I want to find the best SMS service provider and compare pricing information across different countries.

TaskList.description: Research various SMS service providers to identify potential candidates for comparison.
Retrieve pricing information for SMS services in different countries for each of the identified providers.
Gather detailed profile information of the top three SMS service providers based on the pricing and features retrieved.
Compare the pricing and profile details of the top three SMS service providers to assist in decision-making.
